name: TUM-VI room1
description: Calibrated stereo-camera and IMU recording for reproducible visual-inertial estimator integration and configuration comparisons.
duration_basis: Elapsed time between the first and last paired camera samples.

timestamps.encoding: Decimal integer strings preserve absolute timestamps beyond JavaScript's safe integer range.
timestamps.stereo_pairing: Identical timestamps in the two camera streams.

calibration.camera_extrinsics_convention: T_cam_imu transforms IMU-frame coordinates into camera-frame coordinates.
calibration.pose_convention: Position in metres; unit Hamilton xyzw quaternion rotating the IMU/body frame into the reference world frame.
calibration.dataset_preprocessing: The calibrated export already corrects IMU scaling/alignment and synchronizes clocks. These corrections must not be applied a second time.
calibration.image_conversion: The qualified adapter converts uint16 PNG samples to uint8 with the fixed scale 255/65535 before tracking.

reference.purpose: Independent evaluation only; never an estimator input or initialization source.
reference.coverage_basis: Reference support over all 2821 paired camera timestamps under evaluation protocol version 1; distinct from estimator-output coverage.

provenance.attribution: TUM VI Benchmark: David Schubert, Thore Goll, Nikolaus Demmel, Vladyslav Usenko, Joerg Stueckler, Daniel Cremers (2018).

capabilities.scope: Recording compatibility and completed local reference qualification.

limitations: Handheld recording; the local qualification does not establish drone-flight, embedded, or real-time performance.
Motion-capture support has gaps: 65 camera timestamps cannot be evaluated under the declared interpolation rule.
The qualification covers the OpenVINS baseline on room1 only; configuration variants and room2 are not evaluated.
Reference evaluation uses a global rigid alignment with fixed scale; aligned orientation error does not independently validate absolute gravity alignment.
Catalog metadata does not establish hosted recording availability or enable server-side execution.
repository_link_base: Repository root; relative source links identify public files, not hosted dataset-download endpoints.
